it-came-upon-a-midnight-.lyrics:
[00:00.00]It came upon the midnight clear,
[00:06.76]That glorious song of old,
[00:13.74]From angels bending near the earth
[00:19.80]To touch their harps of gold:
[00:27.54]"Peace on the earth, good will to men,
[00:35.00]From heaven's all-gracious King."
[00:43.08]The world in solemn stillness lay
[00:51.66]To hear the angels sing.

[00:59.45]Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
[01:07.86]The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
[01:18.10]The stars in the sky looked down where He lay,
[01:28.06]The little Lord Jesus, asleep on the hay.

o-little-town-of-bethleh.lyrics:
[00:00.00]O little town of Bethlehem,
[00:06.16]How still we see thee lie!
[00:13.44]Above thy deep and dreamless sleep
[00:19.94]The silent stars go by;
[00:27.94]Yet in thy dark streets shineth
[00:35.74]The everlasting Light;
[00:42.80]The hopes and fears of all the years
[00:52.72]Are met in thee tonight.

i-saw-three-ships-o-come.lyrics:
[00:29.80]I saw three ships come sailing in,
[00:31.30]On Christmas Day, on Christmas Day;
[00:33.30]I saw three ships come sailing in,
[00:35.30]On Christmas Day in the morning.

[00:42.40]And what was in those ships all three?
[00:44.50]On Christmas Day, on Christmas Day;
[00:46.50]Our Saviour Christ and His lady,
[00:48.60]On Christmas Day in the morning.

[00:52.60]O, they sailed into Bethlehem,
[00:54.60]On Christmas Day, on Christmas Day;
[00:56.70]O, they sailed into Bethlehem,
[00:58.70]On Christmas Day in the morning.
[01:01.50]

[02:29.80]O come, let us adore Him,
[02:41.70]Christ the Lord.
[02:46.00]

hark-the-herald-angels-s.lyrics:
[00:59.45]Hark! the herald angels sing,
[01:02.34]"Glory to the newborn King;
[01:07.06]Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
[01:12.30]God and sinners reconciled!"
[01:17.26]Joyful, all ye nations, rise,
[01:22.14]Join the triumph of the skies;
[01:27.00]With th'angelic host proclaim,
[01:32.00]"Christ is born in Bethlehem!"
[01:37.26]Hark! the herald angels sing,
[01:42.34]"Glory to the newborn King!"

o-tannenbaum.lyrics:
[00:00.00]O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum,
[00:05.70]Wie treu sind deine Blätter!
[00:09.60]O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum,
[00:15.50]Wie treu sind deine Blätter!
[00:20.50]Du grünst nicht nur zur Sommerzeit,
[00:25.30]Nein, auch im Winter, wenn es schneit.
[00:29.70]O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum,
[00:37.20]Wie treu sind deine Blätter!
